individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where individual points are the data (n=141 samples plotted individually); marginal histograms show distributions, not averages requiring overlay.
Scatter plot of per-reporter means with error bars; scatter plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlay.
Line/density plots showing distributions of subtype-averaged periods and amplitudes; line plots are exempt.
Box plots with individual sample data points overlaid as dots on top of the boxes.
Polar histograms showing distributions of phase differences per cell line, not simple mean bar charts requiring point overlay.
Polar histogram of subtype-averaged phase differences; a distribution-type histogram, exempt like panel E, with individual cell-line data shown separately in panel E.
Example line/curve fit schematic illustrating the fitting model, not an averaged summary statistic plot.
Scatter plot where each point represents an individual sample (n=117 samples) with fit-derived error bars; scatter plots are exempt.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - no error bars present, individual scatter points plotted directly.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean +/- s.d. of 6 samples per reporter (n = 2 biological replicates a technical triplicates or duplicates [HCC1806 Per2-Luc, n = 5]). n = 3 for MCF10A and MDAMB468-Per2-Luc (single experiment).
error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - error bars are explicitly defined as mean +/- s.d. in the caption.
not needed - density/line plots without error bars.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: the bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses.
error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - box, whiskers, median, and outliers are all explicitly defined in the caption.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Error bars represent the standard deviation of the fitted parameters, reflecting their uncertainty as determined by the fitting process.
